Subject: Evidence request: admin activity snapshot & delivery

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. To move our SOC 2 review forward we need an evidence bundle covering admin activity for the period 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-01. Specifically we require:

- A snapshot of admin activity (create/update/delete of accounts, privilege changes, role assignments, API key rotations) with full timestamps (ISO 8601) and actor identifiers.
- A machine-readable manifest containing checksums for each file and a fingerprint for the overall bundle.
- Chain-of-custody / transfer log showing who packaged and uploaded the bundle.
- Retention statement: default retention for these logs and any caveats (ephemeral KV cache entries, redaction policy).

Can you confirm format (JSONL vs parquet), checksums expected (SHA256 preferred), and whether you support an attested manifest (signed by Redwood) we can verify? Also send proposed delivery options (SFTP, presigned S3, or our secure upload endpoint) and an ETA.

Appreciate if you can loop in the technical contact who will prepare the bundle.

—Ava

Ava — thanks for the clear list. We can provide exactly that. High-level proposal: 

1) Format and packaging
   - Primary payload: gzipped JSONL (one event per line) named admin_activity_20260901-20261101.jsonl.gz
   - Manifest: JSON manifest (manifest.json) with per-file SHA256 and file sizes
   - Detached signature: manifest-signature.det (RSA-PSS 4096, sha256) for attestation

2) Fields included (example): timestamp, event_id, actor_type, actor_id (redwood-id), action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, session_id, ip, region, and redaction_flags.

3) Retention and caveats
   - Default retention: 90 days for high-fidelity admin events. For compliance exports we can provide up to 12 months on request (this bundle will include the full 2-month window you requested).
   - Ephemeral entries (KV cache hits) are not included unless requested; we can include operator cache invalidation events separately if needed.

4) Delivery options
   - Presigned S3 (preferred) with time-limited URLs and server-side encryption; or
   - SFTP upload (mutual-auth) to your host; or
   - Secure MedicoSys upload endpoint (if you provide access details).

Next steps: Kar (karthik_iyer) will prepare the packaging and sign the manifest. Marissa (marissa_cole) will coordinate the legal handshake (DocuSign) and chain-of-custody PDF. If you confirm preferred transfer method, we’ll target EOD Tuesday (2026-11-30) for delivery.

Ben

Hi all,

Technical confirmation from infra: we will produce the bundle as Ben outlined. Notes on implementation details so MedicoSys can validate on receipt:

- Primary export: admin_activity_20260901-20261101.jsonl.gz (newline-delimited JSON). Each event will be a single JSON object; schema v2.1 attached below as a quick example.

Example event (newline-delimited):
{
  "timestamp": "2026-10-15T14:22:13.123Z",
  "event_id": "evt_1f8a...",
  "actor_type": "operator",
  "actor_id": "redwood:usr:87431",
  "action": "role.grant",
  "resource_type": "project",
  "resource_id": "proj-alpha-42",
  "request_id": "req_9c2d...",
  "session_id": "sess_7a1e...",
  "ip": "22.33.44.55",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "redaction_flags": []
}

- Manifest schema: top-level fields: bundle_id, generation_ts, file_entries (array), fingerprint (sha256 of concatenated sorted file checksums), producer (redwood-inference), attestation_signature (path to detached signature).

- Checksums: per-file SHA256 hex and also a base64 SHA256 for cross-checks. We will include both to match different verification tool expectations.

- Signature: we will produce an RSA-PSS 4096 detached signature over the manifest.json. Public key (PEM) will be included in the chain-of-custody.pdf.

- Transfer: we can upload to a presigned S3 URL you provide, or we can issue presigned GETs for you to pull. For mutual-auth SFTP we will provide host key fingerprint and username.

Attachments to be uploaded with the bundle (placeholders):
- admin_activity_20260901-20261101.jsonl.gz (payload)
- manifest.json (bundle manifest)
- manifest-signature.det (detached signature)
- chain-of-custody.pdf (who prepared/approved/uploaded)

I will stage the files in a hardened export bucket and generate the manifest within an isolated packaging task to preserve auditability. ETA: packaging complete by Mon 2026-11-30 16:00 PT; if MedicoSys needs earlier we can prioritize.

—Kar
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
